scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && node scripts/check-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-plugin-bundle.mjs
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run test:integration -w packages/vscode-extension
scripts.test:linux: docker build -q -f scripts/linux/Dockerfile -t local-review-linux-tests . && docker run --rm --shm-size=2g -v local-review-linux-vscode:/home/node/repo/packages/vscode-extension/.vscode-test local-review-linux-tests
scripts.coverage:integration: npm run build -w packages/cli && npm run test:integration:coverage -w packages/vscode-extension && node scripts/check-coverage.mjs
scripts.build:release: npm run build:claude-plugin && npm run package
